hero.headline: Color-soaked stories painted by hand
hero.description: I craft vibrant, tactile paintings that invite you to pause, breathe, and feel. Each piece is made slowly and intentionally for intimate spaces that celebrate light.

home.storyBody: From large-scale statement pieces to intimate works on paper, my paintings are built on layers of color, translucent glazes, and marks collected from travel. I believe art should feel personal, tactile, and alive.
home.collectorInvite: Collectors receive first access to new releases, studio visits, and commissions. Let's find the perfect piece for your space.

originals.title: Original paintings
originals.intro: Every painting is created in small batches in my light-filled studio. Works ship worldwide, crated with museum-grade materials and insured delivery.

about.title: Adri Bru
about.paragraph1: Colombian and Italian. My creative practice moves across different languages: design, ceramics, and painting. The medium may change, but the impulse remains the same: to give form to something that did not exist before.
about.paragraph2: My work is born from improvisation and trust in the gesture. I work without sketches or predetermined plans, allowing my hand to move freely until I discover characters I did not know before I began.
about.paragraph3: I do not draw what I see. I discover what was waiting to appear.
about.paragraph4: Each line preserves the energy of the moment in which it was created: the uncertainty, the impulse, the accident, and the decision. I do not seek perfection in the line, but honesty. It is within this freedom that I find my language and my characters acquire identities of their own.
about.paragraph5: In my process, line, colour, and material coexist. Spontaneous marks and expansive fields of colour open new paths, allowing each figure to emerge freely, without a preconceived image determining the result.
about.paragraph6: Each work is an encounter with the unexpected. A unique piece, born without predetermined answers and created to preserve the unrepeatable emotion of that moment.
about.paragraph7: Every line is a path. Every face, a story.
